articles.title: Libyan unity talks upended as warlord’s son linked to drone attacks on fuel facilities
articles.highlight: 西部的民族团结政府称，在美军支持的合并计划破裂后，与萨达姆·哈夫塔尔合作“不可能”。
articles.summary: 有关卡利法·哈夫塔尔之子萨达姆·哈夫塔尔监督一个“恐怖小组”、对利比亚西部燃料储存设施和发电站发动无人机袭击的指控，打乱了位于的黎波里的民族团结政府继续与哈夫塔尔合作推进国家统一计划的安排。萨达姆·哈夫塔尔是所谓利比亚国民军副指挥官，美国日益将其视为统一利比亚安全、司法和政治机构计划中的重要人物。这则国际新闻值得关注，因为它牵动美国支持下的利比亚统一进程。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键点：针对哈夫塔尔之子的指控直接冲击了美国支持的利比亚统一安排，使西部政府与哈夫塔尔阵营继续合作变得困难。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Western Libya’s GNU say working with Saddam Haftar ‘impossible’ as US-backed merger plan breaks down Allegations that the son of the Libyan warlord Khalifa Haftar oversaw a “terror cell” that launched drone attacks on fuel storage facilities and power stations in western Libya have upended plans for the Tripoli-based government of national unity (GNU) to continue cooperating with Haftar on a plan to unify the country. Saddam Haftar, the deputy commander of the so-called Libyan National Army (LNA), has increasingly been seen by the US as an important figure in its plans to unify Libyan security, judicial and political institutions.

articles.title: The Dandelion and the Meaning of Life: G.K. Chesterton on How to Live in Wonder
articles.highlight: 重新拾回那种“对我们自身存在的被遗忘的烈焰或惊愕”，让它在我们被现代性磨钝的心底重新活过来。
articles.summary: 这篇文章借切斯特顿笔下的蒲公英，谈现代人如何失去了对自身存在的惊奇感。作者认为，日常的麻木与习以为常让我们遗忘了生命本应有的震撼，而重新找回这种惊叹，正是生活意义的来源。适合想在日常中重建感受力与精神活力的读者。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启发：真正的活力不来自外部新刺激，而来自重新学会对习以为常之物感到惊奇。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Recovering the "forgotten blaze or burst of astonishment at our own existence" alive in the back of our modernity-deadened minds.

en.highlight: Recovering the "forgotten blaze or burst of astonishment at our own existence" alive in the back of our modernity-deadened minds.
en.summary: Drawing on Chesterton's dandelion, this piece examines how modern people lose their sense of wonder at their own existence. Habit and numbness make us forget the astonishment life should carry, and recovering that astonishment is where meaning is found. It is worth reading for anyone wanting to rebuild receptivity and spiritual vitality in daily life.
en.failureAnalysis: Key takeaway: vitality does not come from new external stimulation, but from relearning to be astonished by what we take for granted.

articles.title: ZJU-REAL/Easel
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: Easel 是浙江大学相关团队开源的 AI 社交媒体智能体，定位是把「找热点—写内容—多平台发布—复盘效果」串成一条自动化链路，覆盖小红书、抖音、知乎、哔哩哔哩等国内主流平台，GitHub 已积累 2984 星。它值得关注的地方在于：它不是单点工具，而是试图把内容运营的完整工作流交给 agent 闭环，这代表了 AI 应用从「生成一句话」走向「替人干活」的方向。
articles.failureAnalysis: 多平台发布依赖各平台的账号授权与接口能力，规则和风控随时变化，一旦被封禁或限流，工程维护成本会迅速上升，这是最现实的失败点。内容创作本身高度同质化，若产品无法用数据证明能带来真实涨粉或转化，用户很难持续付费，需求强度存疑。自动抓取热点趋势还牵涉版权与平台合规风险，叠加模型调用与内容审核的边际成本随发布量线性增长，规模越大越难盈利。
articles.highlight: 发现热点趋势、创作内容、一键发布到小红书、抖音、知乎、B站等平台，并学习哪些内容真正有效。

en.highlight: An open-source AI agent for social media: discover trends, create content, publish everywhere, and learn what works across Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Zhihu, and Bilibili.
en.summary: Easel is an open-source AI social media agent that aims to automate the full loop of trend discovery, content creation, multi-platform publishing, and performance learning across Chinese platforms such as Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Zhihu, and Bilibili, with about 2,984 GitHub stars. It is worth reading because it shows AI applications moving from single-shot generation toward agents that actually run an operational workflow end to end.
en.failureAnalysis: Its viability hinges on platform APIs, account authorization, and risk-control rules that can change or ban automation overnight, driving heavy maintenance costs. Automated content also risks homogenization and unclear ROI, while scraping trends raises compliance issues and model plus moderation costs scale with publishing volume.
en.title: Easel: An Open-Source AI Agent for Social Media Publishing
